_instructions: MANUAL PRODUCT FEED — used until Amazon PA-API access unlocks.
Add products you've picked by hand. For each one:
1. Find the product on amazon.com while logged into your Associates account.
2. Use the SiteStripe bar (top of page) -> Get Link -> Text, and paste that
tagged URL into affiliate_url. NEVER hand-build links without your tag.
3. Copy title and price exactly as Amazon shows them TODAY. No made-up
discounts, no invented claims — the page renders exactly what you put here.
4. image_url: right-click the main product image -> Copy Image Address.
The category key (e.g. Beauty) becomes the section heading on the page.
Run ./run_daily.sh (or wait for the 7am run) after editing to publish.
